subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should this issue remain the broad Control UI zh-CN tab-localization tracker while maintainers sequence the focused tab PRs, or should it be narrowed in favor of separate per-surface localization trackers?
rationale: Current main still has source-reproducible English UI copy, but the remaining work crosses multiple overlapping PRs and translation-scope decisions that automation should not resolve by opening another broad fix branch.

options.title: Keep broad UI tracker
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring each PR to follow the generated i18n pipeline and avoid unrelated surfaces.

options.title: Narrow to original tabs
options.body: Limit this issue to Agents, Skills, Channels, Sessions, Nodes, and Debug, and route Settings, chat metadata, docs, CLI, and runtime localization to linked issues.

options.title: Supersede into localization epic
options.body: Move remaining scope to a larger localization-coverage issue only after choosing a canonical tracker and preserving these tab-specific findings.

recommendation.title: Keep broad UI tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring each PR to follow the generated i18n pipeline and avoid unrelated surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent UI/i18n routing signal among the likely owners and is already named in related localization discussions.
